item.title: [Suratha.lk] Seylan Cards has partnered with City of Dreams Sri Lanka, to present ‘This Is Michael: Relive the Legend’, a live tribute to the legacy, music, and energy of Michael Jackson. Held at City of Dreams Sri Lanka, from the 8th to the 9th of November 2026, the event offers Seylan Cardholders the unique opportunity to immerse themselves in premium entertainment and create extraordinary memories. Standing as an internationally acclaimed Michael Jackson tribute production, ‘This is Michael: Relive the Legend’ has travelled across 15 countries and 25 cities. Performed by Lenny Jay, the tribute show honours the voice, costumes, and the iconic presence of Michael Jackson and his immense impact on the world, backed by an exhilarating cast of singers, dancers, and musicians. The partnership expands Seylan Cards’ proposition, effectively opening the doors to exclusive entertainment, lifestyle, and experiential opportunities and allowing Cardholders to step into the experience of an authentic Jackson performance. Staying true to its promise as “The Essential Card for Your Heartfelt Essentials,” the partnership allows Seylan Cards to extend its offerings as a gateway to extraordinary experiences, providing Cardholders an exclusive 20% off discount for Seylan Visa Infinite, Visa Signature, and World Mastercard Cardholders and 15% off for Seylan Visa Platinum, Visa Gold, Mastercard Freedom, and Debit Cardholders. Speaking about the collaboration, Head of Cards, Seylan Bank PLC, Ruchith Liyanage, commented, “Music is all about connection and creating memories that touch the heart. No one’s music does this better than Michael Jackon. Not only does our collaboration with City of Dreams Sri Lanka reflect our shared commitment to bringing these exclusive experiences to our customers, it also emphasises our commitment to offering Cardholders more than just financial benefits by creating access to truly memorable lifestyle and entertainment choices.” Celebrating one of music’s greatest and most enduring legends, ‘This Is Michael: Relive the Legend’ emphasises a unique proposition and aligns with Seylan Cards’ broader goal of unlocking experiences and moments that Cardholders can enjoy and remember. In anticipation of the event, Seylan Cards will also conduct a ‘Swipe & Win’ promotion from September to October 2026, offering 10 winners the chance to win two VIP tickets each, valued at LKR. 20,000 per ticket, to the event. Open to all Seylan Credit and Debit Cardholders, the contestants may enter the draw through a minimum transaction of LKR. 10,000. Multiple qualifying transactions during the promotional period will provide Cardholders with additional chances of winning. With exclusive savings available to Seylan Cardholders, customers have added reason to make their experience of Michael Jackson’s tribute performance a night to remember. Seylan Cardholders are encouraged to make the most of this once-in-a-lifetime opportunity and secure their tickets. Discounts are subject to availability. Terms and conditions apply. For more details, visit www.seylan.lk.
